The Problem

Volume came fast. Qualification didn't.

This brand competes against low-cost, high-volume players like Ro and Hims & Hers, but is priced for a different customer — one who can afford a premium, clinic-backed program. The default setup didn't know the difference.

Targeting

Platform-default audience

Broad, platform-recommended targeting pulled in clicks from far outside the clinic radius and well below the income band the pricing was built for.

Funnel

Generic template page

The out-of-the-box template funnel wasn't written for this audience or this offer — it didn't earn the trust a cold click needs to convert.

02 / 07
What I Built

A four-stage funnel, coded from scratch

Every screen below is the actual live page — brand marks blurred for confidentiality.

Stage 01 · Entry — Opt-In Quiz

Eligibility Assessment

A 7-question qualifying quiz that screens for BMI/health-marker eligibility before any sales messaging — the first checkpoint against income and location criteria.

  • Filters intent before the sales page, not after
  • Collects contact info only once eligibility signals are captured
Stage 01 · Continued

Contact Capture

The final quiz step, where the lead hands off name, phone, and email so a provider can reference their answers during the assessment.

Stage 02 · Persuade

Sales Page

Custom-coded to lead with the hybrid differentiator — telehealth convenience plus a real, in-person clinic doctor — the thing low-cost competitors can't offer. Provider video replaces generic stock creative.

Stage 02 · Continued

Fit Filtering, In Copy

A "this is / isn't for you" block placed mid-page, doing qualification work in the copy itself before the lead ever reaches the calendar.

Stage 02 · Continued

Objection Handling

FAQ block addressing speed-to-start, care model, and payment before the final CTA — reducing drop-off from unanswered questions.

Stage 03 · Commit

Calendar Booking

Direct scheduling into a clinic consultation — the point where a click becomes a real, dated commitment.

Stage 04 · Confirm

Thank You

Triggers the automated pre- and post-booking email and SMS sequence, keeping the lead warm before their consultation.

The Pivot

Same traffic budget, rebuilt targeting and funnel

Toggle between what was running before the optimization and what replaced it.

Targeting

  • Platform-recommended broad audience
  • No income filtering
  • No geographic radius logic

Funnel

  • Default template page
  • Generic copy, not written for this audience
  • No clinic-radius or pricing context set

Targeting

  • Lower income bracket excluded
  • Radius logic around each physical clinic
  • Keyword set narrowed to high-intent, clinic-specific terms

Funnel

  • Custom-coded 4-stage funnel
  • Copy built around the hybrid telehealth + clinic differentiator
  • Automated email sequence on booking and thank-you

The Automation Behind It

Form submit → notify → nurture → close

Three connected workflows: an internal notification the moment a lead submits the assessment, a day 1–15 email + SMS nurture sequence for leads who haven't booked, and an automatic cleanup that removes a lead from nurture and logs the opportunity the moment they book.

Workflow 01

New Lead Notification

Fires the instant the self-assessment tag lands on a contact — an internal notification so no lead sits unseen.

Workflow 02 · Day 1–15

Nurture to Booking

Alternating email and SMS touches with wait steps in between, spaced across a 15-day window for anyone who hasn't booked yet.

Workflow 03

Booked → Clean Exit

The moment a lead books, they're pulled out of the nurture sequence, the opportunity is logged, and a confirmation SMS goes out — no duplicate messages after that.
